newsitem.title: USA: Micron Electronics to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Micron Electronics to offer shares.

text.p: Micron Electronics Inc and Micron Technology Inc jointly announced Friday that the company filed a prospectus supplement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of 13.5 million shares of the company's common stock.

Of the total shares to be offered, 3 million will be offered by the company and 10.5 million will be offered by selling shareholders, substantially all of which will be offered by Micron Technology Inc.
The underwriters will be granted an option to purchase up to an additional 2.025 million shares of the company's common stock to cover over-allotments, if any.
Proceeds to the company of the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures and working capital.

Micron Technology Inc. owns about 79 percent of the outstanding common stock of the company. The sale of shares offered will reduce the ownership of Micron Technology Inc to about 66 percent of the outstanding Common Stock of the company (about 64 percent if the over-allotment option is exercised in full). Proceeds to Micron Technology Inc. of the offering will be used for general corporate purposes.

The shares are being offered in the United States and internationally in an offering managed by Goldman, Sachs & Co., Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Montgomery Securities and Robertson, Stephens & company.
